subject.title: fix(approval): distinguish policy vs non-persistable reason when Allow Always unavailable

question: Should maintainers adopt this `ask`-threading branch as the canonical fix for the linked non-persistable Allow Always wording bug, or prefer a competing typed-reason implementation?
rationale: Multiple open contributor PRs solve the same root cause with different API shapes; automation can verify this branch but should not choose the permanent approval-surface direction on maintainers' behalf.

options.title: Use this PR as canonical
options.body: Land this narrow, proof-positive branch and close the duplicate approval-prompt PRs as superseded after merge.

options.title: Choose a typed-reason PR
options.body: Prefer a broader implementation that carries an explicit unavailable reason through the approval model, then close this branch only after that replacement is merged or clearly viable.

options.title: Pause the cluster
options.body: Hold all open candidate PRs until an approval-area owner decides the final API shape.

recommendation.title: Use this PR as canonical
recommendation.body: Land this narrow, proof-positive branch and close the duplicate approval-prompt PRs as superseded after merge.
